biggest_catch: The $500 payout cap is per lifetime, not per year - after 10 referrals you can never earn again, though your friends still can.
catches: Referrer and friend each receive $50 when the friend opens a first CUA Core Checking Account.

Friend requirements: 18+, first CUA Core Checking Account with a $100 minimum initial deposit kept for at least 30 days, valid referral code at account opening, Kansas resident, and a CUA membership in good standing.
Payout limit is $500 per member, per lifetime (ten $50 bonuses); referrals beyond ten still pay the friend their $50.
$50 awarded within 60 days of the referred checking account opening.
Fees may reduce earnings; bonuses may be reportable to the recipient and IRS.
CUA employees and volunteers are not eligible.
CUA may disqualify referrals or change or end the offer at any time.
Referral code must be traced via digital banking or the shared email link.
